analyses.content: 录音中明确提到这学期的上课时间定在了七点半（seven-thirty）。
你可能会听到上学期的“六点半（six-thirty）”而急于填错，做题时务必听清表示现在的提示词“this time”。
Right. I know it's on Tuesdays, but what time exactly? It was six-thirty last term, but let me just have a look at the details. Okay, it'll be seven-thirty this time. Probably it suits more people.
录音中明确说明除了装水的罐子，还需要带一些画画用的铅笔（pencils）。
你可能会被录音里的颜料（paints）或围裙（aprons）干扰，但这些是老师提供或现场有的，不需要自己带，同时注意填入复数形式。

Um, what does she need to bring? Okay. Well, paints are provided by the tutor, I know that. Um, the information says she'll need just a jar for water and some pencils for drawing. There are also lots of aprons here, so she needn't worry what she's wearing.
录音指引路线时提到，沿着楼梯一直走到顶端（top），就能找到那个小房间。
你可能会在长句中听到入口（entrance）或楼梯（stairs）就盲目填入，要注意听介词搭配“to the”背后真正的终点位置。

Which room will that be in? When you come in through the entrance of the community center building, you'll need to go straight up the stairs in front of you, all the way to the top, and it's the small room you'll find there.
男士确认七月的课程被推迟到了八月（August），女士随后用“I'm afraid so”给予了肯定。
录音里接连出现了七月（July）和六月（June），你需要抓住关键动词“delayed until（推迟到）”来确认最终的月份。

And let me just check when it's starting. I heard from someone that the July course has been delayed until August. I'm afraid so. And we're halfway through the June course at the moment, so there's not much point you taking that. Hmm. I guess we'll have to wait then.
男士询问带着相机的说明书（instructions）是否有用，女士回答说确实如此（I'd say so）。
你可能会被后面提到的配件（accessories）或额外镜头（lenses）带偏，但录音明确排除了这些物品（no need），别忘了答案末尾的复数s。

Um, obviously I need to bring the camera with me. I suppose it'd be useful to have the instructions that go with the camera too? I'd say so. Um, some people bring along a lot of accessories, like extra lenses, but there's really no need for this class.
录音明确说明报八节课（eight classes）对应的价格是五十五（fifty-five）美元。
你可能会把四节课的三十五（35）或者节省的十五（15）当成答案，要严格将数字和题目要求的“八节课（eight）”对应起来。

And how much does it cost? Uh, let's see. For four classes, it's thirty-five dollars. But if you take eight, it works out as fifty-five dollars, so you're making a bit of a saving. Fifteen dollars, that is.

analyses.content: 录音中明确点出这门水彩画课实际上是为初学者（beginners）设计的。
你可能会捕捉到“skilled”或“professional”，但录音中用“don't have to”和“rather than”对这些词进行了明确的否定排除。

Okay, now just another question for the watercolors class. I've just remembered that my wife asked me to find out about the level. Who's it for? Okay, well, you don't have to be very skilled or anything like that. It's designed for beginners, actually. People who might see art as a hobby rather than as a professional opportunity.
女士在回答联络人时，直接拼出了负责人的姓氏 K-A-H-U-I。
这道题是纯拼写测试，你可能会因为拼读语速快而写错字母，记下每个字母并保持人名首字母大写即可。

And, um, who do I talk to if I want to find out some more about the Maori language classes? Probably best to talk to the tutor directly. He'll be in the office in about half an hour. His name's Jason Kahui. That's K-A-H-U-I.
录音提醒去摄影课之前，不要忘记检查相机的电池（battery）并确保它充满了电。
录音中用“look at”同义替换了题干里的“check”，你可能会因为等待原词而跟丢答案。

Oh, if you do decide to come to the photography class, don't forget to look at your camera battery and make sure it's charged. I know it sounds obvious, but I've seen a few people suddenly find the camera's stopped working right in the middle of class. Yes, I can imagine it'd be easy to forget that.
男士提问最后一周是不是要在本地去参观一个展览（show），女士给出了“Yes”的确认。
答案夹在长问句中，你可能会被稍后出现的城市（city）带偏，做题时紧抓题干中的“a trip to”对应的同义替换“a visit to”即可准确定位。

In the final week of the photography course, is it right that there's a visit to a show in the local area? I work in the city, you see, so I might have to come home early for that one. Yes. They'll decide the date once the class has started.
